annotations.title: Take off plan sheets: counts, lengths, areas per layer

description: Totals a set of drawing sheets as the plan takeoff does: each sheet with its own scale (from a known line, or pixels per mm), counts, lengths and areas read off them in the sheet's pixels, layers adding up across the sheets; returns each layer's total and each sheet's share in metric and US units, unscaled marks left out and named. Points in, no picture; not sized.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

lang.description: The answer's language. en (the default): as ever. es or es-US: US Spanish — labels, units, result lines and the honest machine-translation label from the site's Spanish pages, Spanish words read in a question or a trade term, and links to the /es/ pages once the site publishes them (until then the links stay English). fr or fr-CA (Canadian French, /fr/) and pt or pt-BR (Brazilian Portuguese, /pt/): the same from the site's French and Portuguese pages, figures with a decimal comma; each link names the translated page only once that page is published, otherwise the English page.

sheets.description: The sheets, each with its scale and its marks. At most 500 marks and 20,000 points in all.

countType.description: count only: what is counted (default other).

kind.description: count: each point is one symbol; length: a polyline; area: a closed outline.

layer.description: The layer's name. Marks with one name, on any sheet, are one layer and add up ("Outlets" counted on two floors is one total).

points.description: In the sheet's own picture pixels, as read off the drawing.

anyOf.description: [x, y] in the sheet's picture pixels (y down).

length.description: Its real length, with its unit ("5 m", "16 ft").

line.description: The two ends of something on the sheet whose real length is known (a figured dimension, a scale bar).

anyOf.description: [x, y] in the sheet's picture pixels (y down).

scale.description: This sheet's own scale (sheets in one set are often drawn at different ones). Left out: no scale yet, and its lengths and areas are left out of the totals and counted as unscaled; its counts still count.

system.description: The system lengths are read in (both are returned).

name: plan_set_takeoff

language.description: Only with a lang other than en: the answer's language (es-US, fr-CA or pt-BR), whether its links may name the translated pages (spanishLinks for es-US; localeLinks for fr-CA and pt-BR, where an unpublished page still links in English), and the honest machine-translation label.

englishPages.description: Site page addresses in this answer that open the ENGLISH page, because the translated page is not published yet (the words in the answer may still be translated).

layers.description: Each layer's total across the set, with each sheet's share.

marks.description: Marks in the total (a count layer: one per sheet it is on).

total.description: The set's total in both systems (m or ft, m² or sq ft, each); null when every mark is on an unscaled sheet.

unscaled.description: Marks on sheets with no scale, left out of the total.

sheets.description: Each sheet's own totals, layer by layer.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

language.description: Only with a lang other than en: the answer's language (es-US, fr-CA or pt-BR), whether its links may name the translated pages (spanishLinks for es-US; localeLinks for fr-CA and pt-BR, where an unpublished page still links in English), and the honest machine-translation label.

englishPages.description: Site page addresses in this answer that open the ENGLISH page, because the translated page is not published yet (the words in the answer may still be translated).

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
